Alec Kriebel’s Research

I’m collecting my mathematical research here, with an explanation of each result, its current status, and links to the paper and supporting materials.

I use AI extensively in this work. Unless otherwise stated, these are preprints that have not undergone independent human peer review.

Papers
Free spanning-forest degree can decrease under squaring
22 October 2026 · Probability / infinite graphs · Unrefereed preprint

Adding every two-step connection takes an infinite graph from 8 neighbors per vertex to 40. Yet the expected number of edges touching a vertex in its free random spanning forest decreases. The paper gives an exact calculation and a checkable certificate.

PDF · Zenodo

A continuous free product system not generated by its tensor core
21 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A continuous free product system can contain sectors that its maximal tensor subsystem cannot generate.

PDF · Zenodo

Logarithmic Bray sampling in symplectic and orthogonal groups
22 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Logarithmic sample bounds for Bray’s construction in large symplectic and orthogonal groups over odd finite fields.

PDF · Zenodo

Missing faces and topological embeddings of sphere skeleta
12 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Adding a missing middle-dimensional face to the skeleton of a triangulated sphere prevents embedding it back into that sphere.

PDF · Zenodo

Positive tangent-bundle Seshadri constants characterize projective space
12 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A positive tangent-bundle Seshadri constant at one fixed point forces a smooth projective variety to be projective space, in every characteristic.

PDF · Zenodo

An explicit odd-order p-group with as many automorphisms as elements
15 September 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

An explicit odd-order p-group with exactly as many automorphisms as elements: a computer-assisted proposed solution to Kourovka Notebook problem 16.63.

PDF · Zenodo

Direct Sequence Laws under the Network Multispecies Coalescent: A genealogy equivalence, canonical coalescent-response behavior, and finite determination with an epoch-complexity obstruction
12 September 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

What multilocus DNA sequence laws reveal about gene genealogies, and why demographic complexity limits finite-locus identification under the NMSC.

PDF · Zenodo

Minimum Bell-Setting Complexity for Qubit POVM–PVM Separation
30 July 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Why qubit POVMs need at least three Bell settings on one side and two on the other to beat projective measurements, when shared randomness is allowed.

PDF · Zenodo

Positive Recurrence for Single-Linkage Bimolecular Weakly Reversible Stochastic Reaction Networks
22 August 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Positive recurrence for finite weakly reversible bimolecular stochastic reaction networks with one linkage class, without the pure-species condition.

PDF · Zenodo

Raw Strongly Tree-Child Level-2 Species Networks from Metric Genealogy Laws under the NMSC: Signed pair co-occupancy, rooted graph reconstruction, and demographic fibers
12 September 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Which species-network histories can exact genealogy laws distinguish? A level-2 NMSC classification identifies exposed parameters and unavoidable ambiguities.

PDF · Zenodo

A polynomial versus superpolynomial gap in vertex-distribution-free graph testing
17 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A fixed graph property has polynomial testing cost under uniform vertex sampling but superpolynomial cost with arbitrary vertex weights.

PDF · Zenodo

A smooth Reshetnyak-harmonic sphere with unbounded distortion
13 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A smooth sphere homeomorphism locally minimizes Reshetnyak energy while its infinitesimal distortion has no finite bound.

PDF · Zenodo

Coarse endpoint concentration at every diverging scale for one-dimensional space-time random walks
18 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

One-dimensional random walks in iid space-time environments have sharply concentrated coarse endpoint laws at every deterministic diverging interval scale.

PDF · Zenodo

Finite-energy lattice percolation with internal critical probability one
15 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

An invariant finite-energy percolation on every lattice Z^d, d ≥ 2, has a unique infinite cluster destroyed by every independent thinning below full retention.

PDF · Zenodo

Polynomial-time optimization and exact separation for rational mixed-integer bipartite covers
12 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Exact rational optimization and convex-hull membership for mixed-integer bipartite covers, with polynomial binary-input complexity and unrestricted signs.

PDF · Zenodo

Post-Lie nonexistence with a semisimple target
16 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A unimodular-source obstruction for finite-dimensional complex post-Lie algebras, proving nonexistence for perfect nonsemisimple sources and semisimple targets.

PDF · Zenodo

Property (T) above one-third density in random free-product quotients
15 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Kazhdan property (T) above density one-third for fixed random free-product syllable models with at least three factors, through every integer relator length.

PDF · Zenodo

Pure point Dirichlet spectrum on quasi-conical domains
15 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A connected quasi-conical domain with a complete Dirichlet eigenbasis and dense positive eigenvalues, addressing the Krejčířík–Lotoreichik spectral question.

PDF · Zenodo

Three anti-invariant classes on a nonintegrable four-manifold
16 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A compact four-manifold with nonintegrable almost complex structures and three anti-invariant de Rham classes, addressing the Draghici–Li–Zhang conjecture.

PDF · Zenodo

Signed impulse estimates and global smooth solutions for finite multispecies relativistic Vlasov-Maxwell
6 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A finite-species extension of the OpenAI signed-impulse argument for relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell, with distinct masses and charges and no neutrality assumption.

PDF · Zenodo

A counterexample to Kourovka Notebook Problem 16.45
23 September 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

An explicit group of order 100920 separates minimal permutation bases from independent sets, answering Cameron’s Kourovka Notebook Problem 16.45.

PDF · Zenodo

A two-dimensional complex with embedding-dimension gap two
1 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A finite two-dimensional simplicial complex that embeds piecewise linearly in R³ but needs R⁵ when every original triangle must remain flat.

PDF · Zenodo

An application of separable-state nonrepresentability to Grassmann orbitopes and calibrations
12 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A reduction from separable quantum states rules out finite semidefinite lifts of an oriented Grassmann mass ball and yields a calibration obstruction.

PDF · Zenodo

Asymptotic LOCC dense coding with the symmetric four-qubit W state
4 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A many-copy protocol lets two independent senders use the symmetric four-qubit W state to exceed two bits per copy with LOCC decoding.

PDF · Zenodo

Consistent spectral recovery of smooth reversible diffusion tensors at a fixed lag
5 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A consistency theorem recovers a smooth anisotropic diffusion tensor from stationary observations at one fixed lag using all positive empirical spectral modes.

PDF · Zenodo

Exact Diffusion Design for Maximally Collective Stable Turing Patterns in Binary-Complex Mass-Action Networks
12 September 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Mass-action networks with an unstable subsystem of size n−1, exact diffusion thresholds, and locally stable patterns for every species count n ≥ 4.

PDF · Zenodo

Exact Tree–Theta-Trinet Collisions under the Kimura 2- and 3-Parameter Models
28 August 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Exact Kimura-model examples show a phylogenetic tree and a level-two network can share every DNA site-pattern probability, even with strictly positive parameters.

PDF · Zenodo

Measure-only preserving Markov transports characterize mass-stationarity
6 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Measure-only randomized transports characterize mass-stationarity, including periodic random measures and information beyond the mass itself.

PDF · Zenodo

Non-symmetry of biconstrained two-step reachability
3 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Swapping two connection thresholds changes the guaranteed two-step reachability in finite graphs, with a proved gap of at least 1/108.

PDF · Zenodo

Nonconvexity of fixed odd-power sum-of-squares cones
6 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A finite sextic example shows that requiring a fixed odd power to be a sum of squares need not define a convex set.

PDF · Zenodo

The spatial locus of common tangents to three disjoint convex sets is null
3 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Common supporting tangent lines to three disjoint convex sets in three-dimensional space occupy zero volume, even for nonsmooth or nonclosed sets.

PDF · Zenodo

A flow reduction for equilibrium uniqueness in rank-one bimatrix games
13 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Deciding whether a rational rank-one bimatrix game has exactly one Nash equilibrium is coNP-complete, even when a strict pure equilibrium is supplied.

PDF · Zenodo

A Minimal-Surface Counterexample to a Seshadri Lower Bound
14 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A family of minimal complex algebraic surfaces violates a proposed Seshadri lower bound, using a classical plane pencil and a double base change.

PDF · Zenodo

A modular-storage proof of NP-completeness for chip-firing halting on simple digraphs
16 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

An attributed proof that conservative chip-firing halting is NP-complete on simple strongly connected digraphs, including graphs without opposite arcs.

PDF · Zenodo

Strong Tree-Childness Is a Sharp Generic-Identifiability Boundary for Level-2 Jukes-Cantor Networks
23 August 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Generic topology recovery and explicit ambiguities for level-2 phylogenetic networks under the Jukes–Cantor model, with exact assumptions and supporting materials.

PDF · Zenodo

A negative answer to Nevo's homology-sphere decomposition question
17 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A finite two-dimensional complex is doubly Cohen–Macaulay in characteristic zero yet contains no homology-sphere subcomplex over any field.

PDF · Zenodo

A sharp forest bound and an improved whisker bound for finite WARM graphs
21 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A finite WARM graph preprint gives the sharp strict forest bound α > 4/3 and an equal-rate whisker bound α ≥ 17/4, with source files and limitations.

PDF · Zenodo

A simple brace outside asymmetric products of two trivial braces
17 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A 20,000-element simple left brace answers Cedó’s two-trivial-factor question using a triple-star obstruction that survives every change of coordinates.

PDF · Zenodo

A torus-collar proof of the real-spectrum compact-support classification for Nijenhuis operators
15 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A smooth torus-collar construction realizes any prescribed real-spectrum Jordan matrix locally in a compactly supported Nijenhuis operator.

PDF · Zenodo

A two-cube cubulation of the AIM free-by-cyclic example
12 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

An explicit finite cube complex for the exact group in AIM Question 5.2, with two three-dimensional cells and a proper cocompact CAT(0) cubical action.

PDF · Zenodo

All-load stability of a deterministic-first-chunk file-sharing chain
20 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Positive recurrence for the literal six-rate deterministic-first-chunk chain at every fixed positive arrival rate, with no aggregate cap on seed upload capacity.

PDF · Zenodo

BV generators for polynomial Weyl subalgebras
22 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

A characteristic-zero classification of BV generators for the ordinary Hochschild cohomology of polynomial Weyl subalgebras.

PDF · Zenodo

CoNP-completeness of binary directed chip-firing reachability
15 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Legal chip-firing reachability is coNP-complete for loopless strongly connected directed multigraphs with binary multiplicities and nonnegative chip counts.

PDF · Zenodo

Counterexamples to Satoh's SL(2) representation-filtration conjecture
15 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

Explicit free-group automorphisms separate Satoh’s SL(2) representation filtration from the integral Andreadakis filtration in degrees five and six.
